text: What did the stranger want at the stable? — drug the watchman
why: ¶36 says Hunter was certain the stranger drugged his curried mutton to deprive the stables of their watchman; this is a fair possibility to raise.

text: What was in the stranger's paper? — a drug
why: The stranger offered a folded paper for the boy (¶24, ¶26), and Hunter was drugged (¶34, ¶36), so the paper holding a drug is a reasonable possibility.
